statement: Per-module readiness for the Day-11 Part-2 defensible power/mass calculations. It is acceptable and expected that modules differ: the point is to know exactly where evidence exists. No module is forced ready. No calculation is performed here.

modules.power_detail: Component-boundary reference active power is defensible for TMP117 (0.01155 mW) and OPT3001 (0.00594 mW); BMI270 is a REFERENCE-band (0.018-0.378 mW); MAX86141 is an AFE floor only (LED power OPEN). Part-2 can compute a PARTIAL sensor-IC reference power band for the wrist sensing ICs, explicitly excluding LEDs, MCU, radio, regulator.
modules.operating_point_frozen: PARTIAL (temp 1 Hz, light continuous frozen; IMU/PPG reference-only, deployable open)
missing_fields: MAX86141 LED currents + 64 Hz AFE point
modules.recommended_part2_action: Compute a PARTIAL wrist sensing-IC reference active-power band (temp+light+IMU-band+PPG-AFE-floor), clearly labeled component-boundary and LED-excluded. Do NOT emit a wrist-module system power or any mass.

modules.power_detail: ADS1292R AFE-boundary reference power is defensible (0.67 mW @2ch,250 s/s). Thoracic BioZ (AD5940-class) active measurement power is UNKNOWN. Part-2 can report ECG AFE reference power only.
modules.bom_readiness: PARTIAL (ECG AFE AVAILABLE; BioZ active point MISSING; electrodes/MCU/radio/battery/enclosure MISSING)
modules.operating_point_frozen: PARTIAL (ECG 250 s/s continuous reference frozen; BioZ cadence OPEN)
modules.duty_schedule_frozen: REFERENCE_SCHEDULE_ASSUMPTION for ECG; UNKNOWN for BioZ
modules.recommended_part2_action: Report ECG AFE-only reference power (0.67 mW). Leave thoracic BioZ power NOT_READY. No module total, no mass.

modules.power_detail: ADS1299-4-class EEG has no complete operating point (supply/current/session duty all OPEN). EOG is one added channel on the same (un-quantified) AFE. No defensible reference power.
modules.bom_readiness: PARTIAL (EEG AFE class identified; EOG shared-reference path modeled +2 electrodes; power/mass MISSING)
missing_fields: ADS1299 supply + active current operating point
modules.recommended_part2_action: Do NOT compute head-module power. Keep EOG contact increment=2 (interpretation-independent) as the defensible structural fact. Flag EEG operating point as the top blocker.

modules.power_detail: AD5940-class active BioZ measurement power UNKNOWN; cadence OPEN.
modules.bom_readiness: MISSING (AFE class only; everything else open)
modules.recommended_part2_action: Leave NOT_READY. Lowest-priority module for Part-2 (experimental, LOW confidence).

modules.power_detail: MAX86141-class AFE floor known, but 500 Hz sequencing current, LED currents (dominant), and module boundary are all OPEN.
modules.recommended_part2_action: Leave NOT_READY. Preserve the structural burden facts (+1 optical site, +1 contact region). Do not let the negative HR result zero-out engineering burden.

summary.note: NO module is READY_FOR_REFERENCE_POWER_CALC at the system boundary (MCU/radio/regulator/battery unselected everywhere). Two modules support PARTIAL component/AFE-boundary reference power only. NO module is mass-ready. This is expected; Part-1 maps evidence, it does not manufacture it.
